band.unit: $/m2 of coated face area (measured flat, no deduction under 0.5 m2), Auckland, GST exclusive
band.basis: Sum of eight distinct components: QV water-blast prep row x600 m2 (with a stated +25% for the heavier 3000 psi blast), a QV three-coat exterior acrylic finish row x600 m2 (with a stated +30% for the elastomeric X-200 grade and soffit slowness), QV EWP day-hire rows x15 days, QV mobile scaffold weekly hire x3-6 tower-weeks, QV working-off-scaffolding rows x480 m2, and three labelled allowances (60 lm crack fill, EWP cartage, masking/protection/clean-up). No separate sealer line is added because the coating row already represents a full system including its sealer; the QV 'Prepare Painted Plaster' rows are deliberately not stacked on the blast row. Allowances are 8.9% of the low end and 14.3% of the high end, so the band is established from cited rates rather than judgement. Total for the 600 m2 nominal quantity: $31,240 (low) to $43,800 (high), midpoint $37,520. Spread drivers: soffit share (QV's masonry soffit rate runs ~13% above walls), blast pressure and containment, and whether the EWP is billed 15 or 21 days. Wellington/Christchurch painting rates run ~12-15% below Auckland (water blast WLG 8.0 vs AKL 9.4), so the same scope in those centres sits at the bottom of the band. This is a working estimate band for a cost plan, not a certified price; QV rows are unreviewed and the coating, prep and access lines all rest on stated proxy adjustments.

band.unit: m2 of coated face (600 m2 nominal: 480 m2 wall, 120 m2 soffit)
band.basis: Sum of cited QV CostBuilder rows (Auckland, GST exclusive, unreviewed) plus two labelled allowances for EWP transport and for masking/protection/clean-up. Preparation rests on QV t4:r19 plus the blended t4:r13/t4:r14 prepare-plaster rows; the coating system uses QV exterior applied-finish and high-build acrylic rows scaled from three coats to the two finish coats in scope. Allowances are 8-10% of the total, so the band is carried by published rates, not judgement. Total for 600 m2: $36,000 - $49,600, midpoint $42,800 ($71.34/m2). Excludes GST, preliminaries, margin and design/consent fees, per scope.

band.unit: m2 of coated face area (measured flat, no deduction under 0.5 m2)
band.basis: Sum of ten distinct components above, all amortised over 600 m2, GST-exclusive, excluding preliminaries, margin and consent/design fees per the scope. Band $44.79-83.27/m2, midpoint $64.03/m2. Total for 600 m2: $26,874-$49,962, midpoint about $38,400. The width is driven almost entirely by the finish-coat component, where QV offers only an interior two-coat acrylic-to-masonry rate (low) and an exterior high-build acrylic 3-coat system rate (high) and nothing for exterior two-coat elastomeric over previously painted plaster. Allowances carry about 10% of the low total and 12% of the high total, so the band is established but with low confidence.
